# bit checks BUILD.bit when it loads, naming the offending target and field.
cp unknown_field.bit BUILD.bit
! bit --plan
stderr 'target .t.: unknown field .bogus.; valid fields: command,'

cp wrong_type.bit BUILD.bit
! bit --plan
stderr 'target .t.: field .command.: expected string, got number'

cp missing_field.bit BUILD.bit
! bit --plan
stderr 'target .t.: missing required field .command.'

cp undefined.bit BUILD.bit
! bit --plan
stderr 'undefined .nope. referenced in target .t.'

cp duplicate.bit BUILD.bit
! bit --plan
stderr 'name .t. is already used by a variable'

cp cycle.bit BUILD.bit
! bit --plan
stderr 'dependency cycle detected: a -> b -> a'

cp argument_type.bit BUILD.bit
! bit --plan
stderr 'n: expected string, got number'

cp secret_argument.bit BUILD.bit
! bit --plan
stderr 'BUILD.bit:2:1: .*secret .API_TOKEN. not found'
env API_TOKEN=value
! bit --plan
stderr 'BUILD.bit:2:1: invalid invocation of .t.: parameter .n. cannot receive a secret'

-- unknown_field.bit --
t = exec {
  command = "true"
  bogus = 1
}
-- wrong_type.bit --
t = exec { command = 1 }
-- missing_field.bit --
t = exec {}
-- undefined.bit --
t = exec { command = "#{nope}" }
-- duplicate.bit --
let t = 1
t = exec { command = "true" }
-- cycle.bit --
a = exec {
  command = "true"
  depends_on = [b]
}
b = exec {
  command = "true"
  depends_on = [a]
}
-- argument_type.bit --
t(n : string) = exec { command = n }
group g = [t(n = 1)]
-- secret_argument.bit --
t(n : string) = exec { command = "echo #{n}" }
group g = [t(n = secret("API_TOKEN"))]
